entities.name: Aesrias
entities.description: Famous Akroan hero of Iroas on Theros.

entities.name: Pilun
entities.description: Lord governor of Tynthal who wore a false crown and framed Aesrias.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God followed by Aesrias and his parents.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: The new god Aesrias prayed to.

entities.name: Tynthal
entities.description: City north of One Eye Pass.

events.summary: Aesrias delivers harpy heads to Tynthal but Pilun accuses him of theft.
events.quote: Pilun accused him of stealing gold from a merchant

events.summary: Aesrias is imprisoned below a coliseum and meets a Nyxborn follower of Iroas who heals him.
Aesrias kills the sirens in the arena.
events.quote: Aesrias choked them with their chains and broke their necks.

events.summary: Aesrias sets out to tell King Anax of Tynthal's secession.
events.quote: His next quest would be to go to Akros to inform King Anax of Tynthal's secession

relations.quote: Aesrias was met with suspicion and hostility
